intent.objective: Make ContextCompiler task-contract discovery ignore everything under agent-system/runtime/ and not traverse it (replan of DEMO-002 after a contract whose checks could not pass in the integration copy)
intent.rationale: _find_task_contract globs agent-system/** including agent-system/runtime/worktrees/**, so a leased worktree's copy of a contract can shadow or duplicate the real contract. Review notes on the first attempt (non-blocking): its no-contract test asserted only a bare PlanningError, and discovery still listed every runtime file before filtering them out.
non_goals: Changing how contracts are validated or hashed
Changing context compilation other than contract discovery
acceptance_behavior: Discovery ignores every file under agent-system/runtime/ (worktrees, attempts, integration copies) even when a runtime file is a valid task-contract with the requested task id, and still returns the one real contract and its repository-relative path
When the same task id exists both as the real contract and as a copy under agent-system/runtime/worktrees/, the real contract is returned regardless of path sort order
Discovery behaves identically when no agent-system/runtime directory exists

When no contract exists for the task id outside agent-system/runtime/ (including when the only copy is under runtime), discovery raises the existing PlanningError whose message contains 'task contract file was not found'

Discovery does not list or open files under agent-system/runtime/ before filtering (prune the directory while walking, for example with os.walk and in-place pruning of dirnames), while still examining the remaining JSON files in sorted path order

scope.expected_change_shape: A small change to _find_task_contract in context.py plus one new test module

deterministic_checks: PYTHONPATH=tools/agentctl python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/agentctl/tests -t tools/agentctl -p test_context_runtime_exclusion.py
behavioral_requirements: The new tests use a real temporary repository layout (tempfile) with a task-contract JSON under agent-system/work and a copy under agent-system/runtime/worktrees, and prove the real contract is returned
The no-contract test uses assertRaises(PlanningError) AND asserts the message contains 'task contract file was not found'

ContextCompiler.__init__ reads agent-system/policies/product-data-boundary.json (keys enforcement.allowed_context_roots and enforcement.excluded_by_default), so the temporary root must contain a minimal valid copy of that file written by the test

Every test in the new module must pass in a copy of the repository that has NO .git directory, run with cwd at the repository root, a minimal environment and PYTHONPATH=tools/agentctl: the tests must not run git, must not call git rev-parse, and must locate the repository with pathlib from __file__ (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3])
definition_of_done: The candidate passes the deterministic checks, receives an independent review with no blocking findings, and is integrated unchanged

replan_conditions: The fix needs a file outside the writable set
